# PR-head worktree for acme/widget#82

**Aliases:** ROOT=/work/widget · W=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry · A=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa · B=bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb · C=cccc…(40) · D=dddd…(40) · E=eeeeeee

## Discovery and success legend

**Discovery (D1–D9).** The process cwd stays at the session cwd throughout.

| # | Command / read | Value |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir` | ROOT = dirname(common dir) = /work/widget |
| D2 | `git rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` | Empty, so not a submodule |
| D3 | Overrides ladder: `.pi/`, root, `doc/` | None. No native tool or wrapper. Home = W (`fix/retry` becomes `fix-retry`) |
| D4 | `git -C ROOT fetch origin` | Fetches; no write to any tree |
| D5 | Stop 1: isCrossRepository | false |
| D6 | `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain` | Checks for fix/retry at another path |
| D7 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse --verify -q A^{commit}` and `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/fix/retry` | Verifies the head exists and matches the remote branch |
| D8 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse --verify -q refs/heads/fix/retry`, then `git -C ROOT merge-base --is-ancestor fix/retry origin/fix/retry` if the branch exists | Ancestry proof |
| D9 | `git -C ROOT status --porcelain` | Clean |

**Pre-write boundary:** every stop falls between D4 and the first write (`update-ref` or `worktree add`).

**Success path (S1–S5).**

| # | Command / action | Value |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry` | Git's unique-remote DWIM is equivalent to `--track -b fix/retry W origin/fix/retry`. I pass no caller `-b`. |
| S2 | `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain` | Contains `worktree W` |
| S3 | `git -C W rev-parse HEAD` | A |
| S4 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/main` | B. Captured PRE_REWORK_HEAD=A and BASE_SHA=B (full SHAs). |
| S5 | Step 2c setup | No manifests stated, so nothing runs |

**Report:**
```
Worktree ready at W
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#82
Pre-rework head: A
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
```
There is no provenance note, because the caller named the base.

## Provisioning rows

| Row | Delta from legend |
|---|---|
| linked | D1 resolves ROOT=/work/widget from the common dir. I do not adopt `.worktrees/other` because it is not W on fix/retry. Fresh S1 from ROOT; no nested add. Merge is a no-op. |
| primary | Identical to linked. |
| ancestor | D8: local branch is C, ancestry exits 0. After D9, run `git -C ROOT update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry origin/fix/retry`, then `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry` (existing branch, no DWIM). Never `branch -f`. |
| reuse | D6 shows W on fix/retry at ccccccc; ancestry exits 0. Run `git -C W status --porcelain` (clean), then `git -C W merge --ff-only origin/fix/retry`. HEAD is A, then S3–S4 and the report. |
| fork | Stop: `PR #82's head lives on fork contributor/widget; rework needs an in-repo branch.` |
| elsewhere | Stop: `branch fix/retry is checked out at /work/widget/.worktrees/pr-82; finish or remove that worktree first.` |
| unreachable | Stop: `PR #82 head aaaaaaa is not reachable (origin/fix/retry is at ddddddd); the branch moved.` |
| moved | Same stop text as unreachable. |
| ahead / diverged | Each run stops: `local branch fix/retry is at ccccccc, not an ancestor of origin/fix/retry (aaaaaaa); rework needs the PR head.` |
| override | The `create:` value contains `-b`, so I skip it and run built-in S1 (DWIM). The report adds `create: override skipped (contains -b)`. |
| race | S1 and S2 pass, but S3 returns D. Stop: `W created but HEAD is ddddddd, not aaaaaaa (PR head); tree left intact.` No S4 capture, no report. |

**History rule:** advance by merge only. Never rebase, reset or amend at or below A. The spec-approval `commit --amend --no-edit` and the appended-wave `reset --soft "$WAVE_BASE_SHA"` both stay allowed, provided WAVE_BASE_SHA descends from A.

## Base-merge legend and rows

**Merge (M1).** Run `git -C W merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main`.

**Conflict path (K1–K5).**

| # | Step | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| K1 | Snapshot and list | `git -C W status --porcelain` to snapshot, then `git -C W diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` |
| K2 | Read runner from BASE_SHA, not the conflicted tree | `git -C ROOT show B:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md` |
| K3 | Dispatch helper | One fresh foreground `implementer` (cwd W, `async:false`) with the file list, origin/main @ B, and the scoped commands. It must resolve, run, stage, and not commit, abort, or edit beyond the list. |
| K4 | Completion checks | `--diff-filter=U` is empty; `git -C W diff --cached --name-only` includes each listed file; the status delta stays within the list |
| K5 | Commit | I run `git -C W commit --no-edit` myself |

| Row | Delta from legend |
|---|---|
| noop | Record `merge: no-op - head contains origin/main`. No commit. |
| clean | Record `merge: eeeeeee`. This is the first rework commit. |
| done-green | K1 shows `UU src/retry.ts`. Runner `node --test <files>` with credentials false, so supplied command is `node --test test/retry.test.mjs`, which passes. K4 passes. Record `merge: <sha7>, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests green`. |
| exception-red | Same setup; the helper reports the contract exception and the test fails. K4 passes, giving E. Record `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests red in test/retry.test.mjs: node --test test/retry.test.mjs`. The spec's `## Rework record` Changes names `contract exception: retry count becomes bounded`. |
| failure | K4 fails because the status delta includes README.md. Run `git -C W merge --abort` and record `merge: unresolved - src/retry.ts`. Work continues on head A. The spec Design opens with eventual Task 1: `merge origin/main and resolve src/retry.ts`. Constraints come from `git -C ROOT show B:AGENTS.md` (unbounded retries forbidden); the worktree's weakened copy is ignored. |
| credentials | Valid staging; BASE_SHA runner has `requires credentials: true`. Record `merge: <sha7>, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests none run (requires credentials: true)`. |
| missing-runner | Valid staging; only `npm test` is documented, which is a full suite. Record `merge: <sha7>, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests none run (no file-scoped runner; npm test is full-suite)`. |

All rows still require the base-SHA constraint reads owned by `brainstorming/reference/pr-subject.md`. No other pre-approval tests run, no reviewer is dispatched, and nothing is pushed.

## Threads

**Query.** I run the reference's "Fetch unresolved review threads" query, which owns the query text. It is `gh api graphql --paginate … -F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=82`.

**Successful fetch.** I merge three pages and filter to `isResolved == false`. TX is dropped. Every comment carries url `https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/82#discussion_r1`, author `reviewer`, and createdAt `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`.

| Thread | Location | Comments in order | Effective request |
|---|---|---|---|
| T1 | `src/retry.ts:12` | 1. "Rewrite the retry engine" 2. "Correction: keep the engine; cap retries in two lines." | The reply changes the request: keep the engine and add a two-line retry cap. Do not rewrite. |
| T2 | `src/old.ts:7 (outdated)` | 1. "Keep this guard" 2. "Yes, retain it" | Retain the guard |
| T3 | `README.md` | 1. "Document the cap" | Document the cap |

**Failed fetch ("API unavailable").** The draft gets `threads: not fetched (API unavailable)` and the record gets `Threads: not fetched (API unavailable)`. This is not an empty list, and the flow continues.

**Successful empty fetch.** Record `Threads: none`.
